manifest.name: @heidi-dang/flowdeck-dsh
manifest.description: Native DeepSeek Harness integration, Cordis bundle, runtime broker, and execution host for FlowDeck.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

manifest.author: Heidi Dang

bundle.text:
# FlowDeck DSH Bundle Patch
#
# This patch is applied by DSH's profile boot system after the base bundle
# (dsh-base) and the surface bundle (dsh-web-app or dsh-headless). It inserts
# FlowDeck's host-plane integration rows into the running DSH composition.
#
# Architecture contract:
#   - FlowDeck OWNS: orchestration, Heidi, DAG, workstreams, budgets,
#     governance decisions, verification, evidence, recovery, worktrees.
#   - DSH OWNS: sessions, agent loop, LLM routing, tools, commands, jobs,
#     permissions, filesystem, UI transport.
#   - This patch wires FlowDeck's control-plane into DSH-native services
#     WITHOUT duplicating any DSH-owned subsystem.
#
# Installation:
#   dsh plugin --profile web add @heidi-dang/flowdeck-dsh
#   dsh plugin --profile headless add @heidi-dang/flowdeck-dsh
#
# Version: 0.1.0
# DSH compatibility: >=0.1.0-rc.5

# ── Phase 0: Bootstrap — minimal patch establishing the integration seam ────
#
# The FlowDeck DSH integration is implemented in phases. This initial patch
# establishes the host-plane mount point. Subsequent phases add Heidi
# coordination, workstream execution, runtime broker, governance hooks,
# and FDX tools as they are implemented and verified.
#
# Phase 0 intent: prove the DSH bundle contract end-to-end.
# No FlowDeck orchestration behavior is active yet.

- insert:
    # ── FlowDeck host integration ──────────────────────────────────────────
    #
    # The FlowDeck DSH integration service. Mounts FlowDeck's control-plane
    # alongside the DSH host composition without disrupting any DSH-owned
    # subsystem. Future phases insert additional rows (Heidi coordinator,
    # runtime broker, governance hooks, FDX tools) by targeting this mount
    # point with subsequent patches.
    #
    # This row is INTENTIONALLY minimal in Phase 0. It establishes:
    # 1. The canonical row id (flowdeck) that later patches target.
    # 2. The package reference that DSH's plugin system resolves.
    # 3. Proof that the bundle contract works end-to-end.
    - id: flowdeck
      name: '@heidi-dang/flowdeck-dsh'
      disabled: false

readme.text: Native DeepSeek Harness integration, Cordis bundle, runtime broker, and execution host for FlowDeck.

```
FlowDeck (orchestration runtime)
  https://github.com/heidi-dang/FlowDeck
        │
        │ host-neutral public APIs

**FlowDeck owns:**
Heidi orchestration, planning, task decomposition, DAG scheduling, workstreams,
adaptive concurrency, worktree management, leases, budgets, token reservations,
runtime routing decisions, runtime performance learning, governance decisions,
verification, evidence, integration, recovery, learning, scheduler state.

**DeepSeek Harness owns:**
User conversation, model-visible history, sessions, session log, agent loop,
LLM providers, model selection, subagent infrastructure, tools, commands, jobs,
permissions, filesystem, shell/terminal runtime, UI transport.

**This package owns:**
DSH bundle packaging, Cordis integration, DSH host adapters, DshWorkstreamExecutor,
Heidi ↔ DSH bridge, runtime broker integration, global model-lock enforcement,
FDX DSH tool bridge, DSH governance hooks, FlowDeck DSH commands,
DSH Web projections/events, DSH headless integration, conformance tests.

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
